slides.title: Belonging Matters
slides.content: One of the biggest factors in student success is feeling that you belong. College is easier when: You know people in your group. You feel comfortable asking questions. You have staff you can approach. You build positive connections early.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Belonging Matters'? Select all that apply.
options: You know people in your group
You have staff you can approach
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Belonging Matters.

slides.title: Your Teachers Are Here to Help
slides.content: You can expect staff to: Know your name. Treat you with respect. Teach you effectively. Help when you are stuck. In return, staff expect students to: Attend. Participate. Treat others respectfully. Communicate early when problems arise.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following is a key point about 'Your Teachers Are Here to Help'?
options: You have staff you can approach
You know people in your group
exercise.explanation: This is a key point from the section on Your Teachers Are Here to Help.

slides.title: Your Study Programme Has Several Parts
slides.content: A study programme includes: Your Main Qualification: Coursework, assessments, portfolios and projects. English and Maths: If still required. Work-Related Learning: Placements, employer projects and industry experiences. Tutorials and Personal Development: Support for progress, wellbeing and future planning.

exercise.prompt: What is a key message of 'Your Study Programme Has Several Parts'?
options: It is optional and not required
A study programme includes: Your Main Qualification: Coursework, assessments, portfolios and projects
It applies only to certain students
It is only assessed in exams
exercise.explanation: A study programme includes: Your Main Qualification: Coursework, assessments, portfolios and projects

slides.title: Learn to Use Pro Portal
slides.content: Pro Portal is your main college information system. You use it to: Access your timetable. Check room changes. Read messages. View attendance. Track progress. Checking it daily is strongly recommended.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Learn to Use Pro Portal'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Learn to Use Pro Portal.

slides.title: It Is Normal to Have Worries
slides.content: Common worries include: Workload. New software. Meeting people. Confidence. Finding your way around. Most students share similar concerns when they start.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'It Is Normal to Have Worries'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on It Is Normal to Have Worries.

slides.title: Support Exists
slides.content: College support may include: Learning support. Mental health and wellbeing support. Financial support. Careers advice. Seeking help early is a sensible decision, not a sign of weakness.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Support Exists'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Support Exists.

slides.title: College Is More Than Lessons
slides.content: College life can include: Clubs. Societies. Trips. Competitions. Enrichment activities. These experiences can improve confidence, skills and belonging.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'College Is More Than Lessons'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on College Is More Than Lessons.

slides.title: Reflection Matters
slides.content: Students should think about: What they are looking forward to. What support they may need. Who they have connected with. Small reflections help tutors support students effectively.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Reflection Matters'? Select all that apply.
options: What they are looking forward to
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Reflection Matters.

slides.title: Quick Revision Summary
slides.content: Key points to remember: Get settled and build belonging Learn how college systems work Understand your study programme Use Pro Portal regularly Know where to access support Get involved beyond lessons

exercise.prompt: Which of these points are in the quick revision summary? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: These points are summarised in the Quick Revision Summary.
